answer: The falcon counter is kept in vertex and nebula shows each reset. An copycat therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 25 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 25 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 2192 identities would post 2903 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
